units.population: ACS 5 year B01003 (2017 to 2021) summed from tracts; growth against the 2012 to 2016 release
units.populationGrowth5y: fraction, population now over population five years earlier minus 1 (ACS 5 year B01003 (2017 to 2021) summed from tracts; growth against the 2012 to 2016 release)
units.medianHouseholdIncome: dollars (spatial-ucr mirror of the ACS 5 year 2017 to 2021 tract tables, summed to counties)
units.perCapitaIncome: dollars (spatial-ucr mirror of the ACS 5 year 2017 to 2021 tract tables, summed to counties)
units.incomeBuckets: shares of households in the 16 ACS B19001 buckets, sum to 1
units.medianHomeValue: dollars (spatial-ucr mirror of the ACS 5 year 2017 to 2021 tract tables, summed to counties)
units.medianRent: dollars per month (spatial-ucr mirror of the ACS 5 year 2017 to 2021 tract tables, summed to counties)
units.employment: employed civilian residents 16 and over (ACS B23025_004E summed from tracts)
units.avgWeeklyWage: dollars per week: CBP 2019 annual payroll over employees, private workplace employment, divided by 52
units.laborForce: persons (ACS B23025 (2017 to 2021) civilian labor force and unemployed, summed from tracts)
units.unemploymentRate: percent, ACS B23025 unemployed over civilian labor force
units.hpi: null: FHFA not on disk; medianHomeValue carries the level
units.sectors: shares of employed residents by D41 sector from ACS C24030 (scripts/lib/acs.ts), sum to 1; government is public administration
units.bankDeposits: null: no Summary of Deposits on disk; the engine derives county deposit pools from state totals or, without FDIC data at all, from personal income (D48)
units.centroid: [longitude, latitude] degrees, area weighted centroid of the exterior rings; from the county compilation when the boundary file predates the county (flagged imputed)
units.stateTotalAssets: zero: no FDIC file; generated by the engine at world creation (D48)
units.stateTotalDeposits: zero: no FDIC file; generated by the engine at world creation (D48)
units.bankSeedOffices: FDIC OFFDOM (domestic offices) when present, else OFFICES
units.national: percent for rates and 12 month changes, dollars per barrel for WTI, index level for S&P 500
